mentions.name: Legitize
mentions.description: This app helps detect whether TikTok/Reels videos making money-making claims (like "do this and you'll make 10k a month") are lying, so people can avoid wasting money on hustles that were never legit. It is still early and priced to stay affordable.
mentions.problem: People waste their money on hustles that were never legit, promoted through deceptive videos.
mentions.audience: People who watch get-rich-quick videos on TikTok/Reels and might waste money on hustles that were never legit
mentions.source_excerpt:
Built an app that helps you detect if a video (tt/reels) is lying about those "do this and you'll make 10k a month"!

https://legitize.app/

still very early and im trying to keep it very affordable, since the whole point is I dont want people wasting their money on hustles that were never legit
